dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, are these two watches the same?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ər ðiːz ˈtuː ˈwɑːtʃɪz ðə ˈseɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, they're different. This one is real.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðɛr ˈdɪfərənt. ˈðɪs wʌn ɪz ˈriːəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it's used. But it's very nice.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ˈjuːzd. bʌt ɪts ˈvɛri ˈnaɪs.
